# Gramlot 0.3.32

## Grid

- A grid without a datapath context on itself or an ancestor no longer writes
  `.selectionLength`. Before, such grids (for example a frameGrid on
  `storepath` in a chart report) raised "unresolved relative datapath:
  .selectionLength" at refresh. Selection, `selectedPkeys` and
  `onSelectedRow` work as before.
- The base theme hides a frameGrid toolbar with no children. Search, tools or
  items added to `frame.toolbar` later make it visible again.
